params.body:
## What Ilse saw

On the vehicle detail page, section "Overig": "Netheid interieur: zeer goed", "Netheid exterieur", "Netheid toestand motor", then "Opmerkingen" three times and "Aandacht" with nothing under them. A bare muted label without a value reads as broken.

## Why

The Livewire vehicle form saves an empty string for an untouched textarea; the detail view only checked `is_null()`, so the label rendered for `''`.

## What changes

- New component `x-ui.detail-field` (`resources/views/components/ui/detail-field.blade.php`) renders every label/value pair on the detail page and carries the rule: `filled()` decides, a field without a value is not rendered. It has a `cell` mode for the `<dl>` grids (specs, dates) and a block mode (cleanliness, remarks, image, attention).
- Exception (R S1-8.1, R S2-1.3): required fields (the three cleanliness scales, first registration) keep their label with a quiet "niet ingevuld" (fr/en/de added in `vehicle.php`). First registration said "onbekend" before; it now uses the same word as the other required fields.
- Groups: "Belastingen", "Schade" and "Beschrijving" were already conditional; "Data" and "Overig" each contain a required field, so with the exception above they can never be fully empty and the heading stays.
- Rule R S2-1.19 in `docs/bedrijfsregels/12-s2-eigen-wagenpark-publiceren.md`; the edit form is unchanged.

## Tests

`tests/Feature/StocklistDetailEmptyFieldsTest.php` (3 tests, tagged `@rule S2-1.19`): scales set and remarks saved as `''` renders the three scales and no "Opmerkingen"/"Aandacht"; a filled remark and attention render; a required field without value shows "niet ingevuld" exactly three times. Verified to fail against the old views.

Also green locally: `StocklistDetailPreviewTest`, `CompiledViewsTest`, `RulesCoverageTest`, `RulesIdentityTest`, `AlpineExpressionTest`, `HandlerWiringTest`, `StylesheetSyntaxTest`, `LanguageParityTest`, `SmokeTest` filtered on `ownvehicle|stocklist` (53 pages).

## Screenshots (1440, seeded Ilse case)

Before: `.playwright-mcp/ilse-detail-empty/before-1440.png` (three bare "Opmerkingen", "Aandacht"). After: `.playwright-mcp/ilse-detail-empty/after-1440.png` (only the three scales under "Overig").
params.title: Vehicle detail: empty fields and empty groups are not shown
